0022600147.text: The Utah Jazz (1-4, 13th in the West and 5th in the Northwest, 3 games back) host the Portland Trail Blazers (3-0, 1st in the Northwest and 2nd in the West) in their sixth game of the season, with Utah on a three-game losing streak and 1-3 at home. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but Utah lost all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 124-114 in Portland on March 13, 2026. Utah is missing Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain) and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), and Lauri Markkanen is day-to-day with a wrist injury and a game-time decision, while Portland is missing Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness), Robert Williams III (knee) and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery).
